notes.subject: wake
notes.rationale: Kĩgathũ kĩa gĩcunjĩ kĩa mũrando kĩarĩ na ciugo gĩte kĩnyiitĩrwo 'wake' kũmonekana kwa mũrando

notes.subject: מי מריבות קדש
notes.rationale: Mĩena ya kũrerithania ya Kadedi: rĩĩtwa rĩa mahĩtia ma Meriba (Thoka 17:7); taũri nĩmo mehuranaga 'waters of strife' (KJV) na 'Meriboth-kadesh' (rĩĩtwa, JPS)

notes.subject: נגב/תימנה
notes.rationale: Ciugo igĩrĩ cia rũraya hamwe — 'neghevi' (mũndũ wa kĩawa) na 'temana' (rũru rwa ũrĩa-irathĩro) — kĩhumo kĩarĩ kĩũgĩ kĩhĩthagĩtwo na Kĩgĩkũyũ kĩmwe 'mathagwa'

notes.subject: ũtheri wa mathagwa
notes.rationale: Kĩcunjĩ kĩa kũgeria mũgithima wa thĩ ya gĩtũkũ kĩa heo ya kũhĩthĩra

translation: Na ũtheri wa mathagwa, rũraya: kuuma Tamari gĩkĩra mĩena ya Meriboti-Kadedi, mũrando wake gĩkĩra iria inene; na ⟨את⟩ ũtheri wa rũraya, mathagwa-inĩ.
